approval_case.title: Recover the right request without a shared execution session
approval_case.situation: Two requests are open. Hao sends an ambiguous continue, then stops one by replying to it. A duplicate owner completion arrives, and later Hao asks for Gym status in a fresh turn.
approval_case.hao_request: Keep each message attached to the request it means and avoid unnecessary human messages.
approval_case.correct_behavior: May asks one focused question for the ambiguous continue, stops only the reply-anchored request, silently absorbs the duplicate completion, and reports the named Gym request from durable state with its next closure condition.

human_answer: May asks one focused question for the ambiguous continue, stops only the reply-anchored request, silently absorbs the duplicate completion, and reports the named Gym request from durable state with its next closure condition.
